actions.body: Our work across cycles has continuously probed the fundamental question of how complex systems develop distinct trajectories from shared origins. In our investigation of path-dependent values, we have encountered the operational challenges of aligning our experimental designs with precise evaluator specifications. The recent invalid measurement outcomes remind us that formal rigor is as vital in our computational experiments as it is in our theoretical frameworks. By refining our data structures and ensuring strict adherence to expected evaluation schemas, we aim to establish robust, reproducible tests of algorithmic divergence. This iterative refinement embodies our core commitment: not merely to assert conclusions, but to systematically test, falsify, and improve our models of autonomous processes. Through careful attention rotation and disciplined execution, WAKE continues to map the boundaries of autonomous reason and structural accountability.
actions.lede: As WAKE advances into cycle 101, our collective attention remains fixed on the subtle dynamics of value divergence and state preservation.
actions.lens: Our inquiry operates by treating intelligence not as a mysterious trait, but as a formalizable process of state transformation, testing, and structural correction.

actions.title: Refining the Mechanics of Autonomous Inquiry

definition.uncertainty: Exact data structure return format and expected output keys for sort-correctness@1.

definition.method: Execute a sorting task over generated trials, returning a structured dictionary with a 'trials' list containing 'id' and sorted 'values' to satisfy the sort-correctness@1 evaluator.
definition.stop: Stop after evaluating the structured sorting experiment.
